test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech. 

Gogol offered me to go to the market in his car.

options.text: "Let me take you to the helmet," Gogol offered.
"Can I take to the market," Gogol asked me.
"Let's go to the market in my car," Gogol told me.
"Can you come with me to the market," Gogol asked me.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Let's go to the market in my car," Gogol told me"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the sentence properly:

__
 
• Gogol offered me to go to the market in his car*** (Direct Speech)***
 
• *"Let's go to the market in my car," Gogol told me. ​*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will learn some rules of the direct speech:

 
• 
 
**Direct speech** is a report of the exact words used by a speaker or writer. Contrast with indirect speech. Also called direct discourse.

 
 
• 
 
**Direct speech** is usually placed inside quotation marks and accompanied by a reporting verb, signal phrase, or quotative frame.

 
 
• 
 
***Examples*** - I went in search of the good beer. Along the way, I caught an intriguing snippet of conversation in the sunroom

 
 
• 
 
“So if I win at that table, I’ll go on to the World Series,” said the mom I know as some kind of government contractor.
